snippet.title: THE HULL – Official Trailer | Sci‑Fi Deep Sea Horror
snippet.description:
Descend as a Fathomwalker into the ruined depths of a drowned world in this co-op horror dungeon-crawler FPS. Explore the subterrane with friends, uncover forgotten facilities, and survive what lurks beneath. The Hull awaits.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987150/The_Hull

Follow Development:
https://x.com/MireStudios
http://www.mirestudios.com/

If you enjoy atmospheric sci‑fi horror, survival tension, and derelict industrial spaces, you’ll feel right at home in The Hull.

Subscribe for more devlogs, gameplay previews, and behind‑the‑scenes content.
